_comment: Evidence for every entry in manual_subject_overrides.json. Title as returned by data.europarl.europa.eu.

RC-B10-0146/2025.title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
RC-B10-0146/2025.why: A defence white paper is a SEDE file, not a general foreign-affairs one. 106 votes - the largest single affected procedure in term 10.

B10-0174/2024.title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Council's recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments
B10-0174/2024.codes_predicted: Civil Liberties, Justice and Home Affairs
B10-0174/2024.why: Tobacco control is public health. The codes carry 4.20.03 'Drug addiction, alcoholism, smoking', which the learned table sends to LIBE because most files with that code are narcotics-enforcement files.

RC-B10-0123/2024.title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the urgent need to revise the Medical Devices Regulation
RC-B10-0123/2024.why: Medical devices sit with public health in term 10, where SANT is a standing committee.

B10-0215/2024.title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION on setting up a standing committee on Security and Defence and a standing committee on Public Health
B10-0215/2024.why: A decision on Parliament's own committee structure is constitutional affairs. The 8.40 institutional codes are dropped as procedural, leaving a petition-shaped remainder.

B10-0216/2024.title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION on setting up a special committee on the European Democracy Shield, and defining its responsibilities, numerical strength and term of office

RC-B10-0064/2026.title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration
RC-B10-0064/2026.why: A third-country election resolution is foreign affairs; the culture prediction comes from a stray information-policy code.

RC-B10-0371/2025.title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the detention of EU citizens in the occupied areas of Cyprus
RC-B10-0371/2025.codes_predicted: Civil Liberties, Justice and Home Affairs
RC-B10-0371/2025.why: Detention in the occupied north is a Tuerkiye/Cyprus external-relations matter rather than an EU justice one.
